ChangeBatch.Comment: Tenant API Alias convergence to verified Cell ALB; no service start.

writerReadSchedule.purpose: returned exact change ID status polling

preconditions: exact Source IAM identity, immutable manifest and true fact/start deadlines
same exact active ALB ARN/VPC/DNSName/CanonicalHostedZoneId, same fixed public hosted zone
exact single simple A Alias with currentRecordCanonicalSha256 unchanged; no weighted/failover/geographic or same-name truncated records
only one UPSERT for the exact desiredRecord, preserving Name/Type/EvaluateTargetHealth/zone and all other fields
no writes if any prerequisite changed; no alternative resource/zone/name lookup, no environment start
independentChecks: same exact public zone and active ALB metadata
exact single A Alias equals desiredRecord and matches actual ALB DNSName/CanonicalHostedZoneId
only returned and bound Route53 ChangeInfo.Id read back, status INSYNC
record alignment is not public resolver/cache, API health, login or whole-system acceptance; no service start
risks: This changes routing of the existing public sandbox API name to the verified Cell ALB; DNS propagation and external caches need not update immediately. It does not start the stopped API service or prove API availability.
The one exact UPSERT is not a conditional CAS: a concurrent record change after preflight could still be overwritten. Stop on observed drift; do not simplify routing or modify another name.

Source write permission/SCP compatibility is not proved by prior reads; credential refresh/network/provider logs, partial or unknown submission, and a persistent changed or unchanged record remain possible.

After a durable fixed intent, do not resend, reset attempts, restore the old record, delete resources or use another change batch automatically. Only the exact returned change ID may be polled; unknown ACK does not authorize listing or guessing other changes.

GetChange INSYNC and metadata readback are not public-client cache or application-health acceptance. Existing ALB, hosted zone, storage and other charges may continue; no automatic stop, lease extension or 50 USD hard cap.

No CFN/IAM/ELB/ECS/RDS/image/other DNS record, Secret/PEM/.env/database/public HTTP change is included. This uses the existing independent tenant API DNS scope outside the three reviewed stack templates, not a new stack or temporary-tool implementation.
next: After separate exact approval only: submit this one batch, wait within budget, and independently verify Alias metadata. Then record Cell/tenant/DNS convergence without claiming platform drift or public API/product acceptance.
